title: Jeff Bezos predicts millions will live in space by 2045, says robots will take over work on the Moon
description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos expects millions of people to live in space within the next two decades, while robots take on work on the Moon and elsewhere beyond Earth. Speaking at Italian Tech Week, he linked this vision to advances in artificial intelligence, robotics and space technology.

title: IMF and World Bank meetings leave developing countries with more questions than answers
description: The recent discussions at the International Monetary Fund and World Bank left developing nations feeling uncertain about their futures. Delegates raised alarm over growing debt, inflation, and the burgeoning influence of artificial intelligence, but found themselves without significant solutions. These urgent concerns, alongside geopolitical issues and diminishing aid, paint a challenging landscape for low-income countries as both organizations strive to balance AI advancements with their commitment to sustainable development.
